import pandas as pd

capital_df.head()

# Drop the 'group' and 'color' columns
capital_df = capital_df.drop(columns=['group', 'color'])

# Extract the PC1 values for the beginning of the period (1100 BCE)
beginning_period_df = young_bronze_age_df[young_bronze_age_df['BCE'] == 1100]

# Extract the PC1 values for the subsequent time horizons (1000 to 500 BCE)
subsequent_horizons_df = young_bronze_age_df[young_bronze_age_df['BCE'] < 1100]

# Display the beginning period and subsequent horizons data
